explanation: He was born in Halle in 1685, the same year as Bach. After years in Italy he settled in London in 1712 and became a British subject in 1727.

claims.text: George Frideric Handel was born in Halle, in present-day Germany, in 1685.
Handel was not born in England, Italy or Austria.
Johann Sebastian Bach was also born in 1685.
Handel lived in Italy for several years before settling in London in 1712.
Handel became a naturalized British subject in 1727.
